use: a meeting slide turned into a clip
request: Turn this slide from my team meeting into a 20 second clip for the all-hands. The point: login problems are most of our tickets.

material.name: slide
material.about: the user's meeting slide: a bar chart titled 'Q3 support tickets by cause', total 840; login/password 412, billing 268, shipping 97, other 63

intent: A team lead wants the whole company to see that login problems dominate support.
goal: The viewer remembers that login problems are almost half of all tickets and that fixing them halves the queue.
promise: Where our support tickets really come from.
arc: The total, the login bar alone, the others small beside it, the takeaway.

events.text: Last quarter we got 840 support tickets.
Login problems alone were 412, almost half.
Billing came next with 268. Shipping and everything else together? Just 160.
events.look: billing, then shipping and other, small next to login

holds.does: shipping and other bars wait, unlabeled

events.text: Fix login, and half the queue goes away.
events.look: the login bar, half of the whole

holds.does: the login share stays lit as half of all tickets

quiz.q: How many support tickets were there last quarter?
Which cause came second, and how many?
How many were shipping and everything else together?
Which cause had the longest bar?
Which cause has the smallest bar?
How many tickets does the shipping bar show?
During the pause, how were the shipping and other bars labelled?
